when_to_use: When writing code that calls another service over HTTP.
type: lesson
tags:
  - coding
updated: 2026-09-26
xrefs:
  - memories/payment-api-stall-held-64-threads
---

Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call.
A call with no timeout can wait as long as the other service takes.
When the payment provider's API stalled for 12 minutes, every one of the 64 worker threads of the checkout service ended up waiting on it, and checkout stopped answering.
The calls used the Python requests library without a timeout argument, and requests has no default timeout, so a call waits as long as the server keeps the connection open.
Passing `timeout=(3, 10)` to every call bounds the wait at 3 seconds to connect and 10 to read.
